title: CameraHealthInput
description: Explicit camera health heartbeat or status reporting. Note: an explicitly offline camera forces room occupancy to 'unknown'. A missing heartbeat past the staleness threshold transitions status to 'stale'.

room_id.description: Canonical room identifier where the camera is stationed.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone when health status was evaluated.

status.description: Explicitly communicated health state of the camera/stream.

source.description: Origin of the health telemetry (e.g. cv_service, ping_monitor, mock).
